text: For two decades, the cloud has been shaped by human developers writing code and managing its deployment.

text: Now a growing share of production code is generated by LLMs with little human review.
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: Because that code is not fully trusted, it increasingly runs in isolated, sandboxed environments.

text: Meanwhile, AI agents are starting to operate infrastructure directly by spinning services up and tearing them down on their own.
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: Together, these shifts raise the question of whether the cloud needs to be rebuilt for machine operators rather than humans.
